patch.description:
Allowed fields for PATCH:
- /Description
- /Label
- /Remarks
- /Department
- /YourRef
- /OurRef
- /PaymentTerms
- /DeliveryTerms
- /DeliveryMethod
- /Account
Sample request:
            
    PATCH
    {
      [
        {
            "path": "/Description",
            "op": "replace",
             "value": "description changed"
             },
             {
             "path": "/label",
             "op": "replace",
             "value": "label changed"
        }
      ]
    }
